name: Horizon Boat Tours Barbados
summary: A glass-bottom boat running two-hour snorkel trips along the west coast near Holetown. Trips stop with the hawksbill turtles, over the shipwreck in Folkestone Marine Reserve and, when they are around, with stingrays. The boat can pick you up from the beach in front of a west coast hotel or villa.
standouts: Glass-bottom boat with a water slide and dive platform
Pick-up by boat from the beach side of west coast hotels
Drinks, snacks and snorkel gear included on every tour

trips.title: MORNING TOURS
trips.summary: A morning trip along the west coast on the glass-bottom boat. The first stop is with the hawksbill turtles, the second is a snorkel over the shipwreck in Folkestone Marine Reserve. A third stop is added when stingrays and tarpons are around.
highlights: Turtle stop and a snorkel over the Folkestone Marine Reserve shipwreck
Third stop when stingrays and tarpons are around
Pick-up from Folkstone Marine Park or a west coast beach
Max Guests 25

trips.title: PRIVATE CHARTERS
trips.summary: A private trip on the glass-bottom boat, priced by the size of your group rather than the size of the boat. You choose the time, the length (between 2 and 8 hours), the stops and where you go, including a beach or a beach bar stop. The standard private route visits the turtles, the shipwreck and the stingrays.
highlights: Priced by group size, from 1 to 2 people
Choose your own time slot and length, 2 to 8 hours
Optional beach stop or beach bar and restaurant stop
Ask about the after-tour Bajan Beach BBQ

checkNotes: Every tour page has its own booking widget (WordPress plugin BA Book Everything), with dates open to April 2028, but the pages also say to WhatsApp or call +1 246 257 6527 to book. No wa.me link on the site; the WhatsApp number is the main phone. The contact page gives the office as Holetown and a second address, Taylors Gap, The Garden, St. James. The home page lists other tour types with no page or price: fishing trips, private lunch cruise, private breakfast, party cruises; it also uses 'luxury yacht' wording that does not match the single glass-bottom boat described elsewhere. Years in business differ (about page: 19 years and 16 years; home: 20+ years). About page says tours are no more than 15 persons on a 40-person boat, while the booking pages say Max Guests 25. All tours advertise turtle feeding. Site copyright 2026 and uploads from late 2025, so trading.
